domainhints: Michigan Medicaid inbound 834, behavioural-health plan mapping. SEGMENT GLOSSARY (authoritative): BH indicator = Loop 2320 COB02 = "BH-Cover", accompanied by REF*ZZ*BH-Cover. BH coverage start = Loop 2320 DTP*344. BH coverage end/term = Loop 2320 DTP*345. Member eligibility begin = Loop 2000 DTP*348. Member eligibility end/term = Loop 2000 DTP*349. Plan Coverage Description = Loop 2300 HD04. Never name a date by a bare element position such as DTP01, DTP02 or DTP03. CROSSWALKS: NRTCUSTOMDB.EDI.EE_PlanMapping receives 25 new Behavioral Health rows and is keyed on PlanCoverageDescription + CSHCSIndicator + MemberEligibilityType; EE_TransactionTypeMapping has the 001/33 Third Party Liability ignore flag set to "N". Every COB loop must land in EDIStageArchive.dbo.MemberCOB. BUSINESS RULES (authoritative): a BH-Cover plan can never start before 10/01/2026, so any derived BH start that pre-dates it is floored to 10/01/2026 while the non-BH span keeps its own derived date, which is what splits a member into two spans; MI Medicaid plans always begin on the first of a month, so an effective date that is not the 1st rolls to the 1st of the following month; when DTP*345 is termed but DTP*349 stays open the BH plan terms at month end and the member moves to the Non-BH plan from the first of the next month; when both DTP*345 and DTP*349 are termed the member is termed. TRANSACTION COMBINATIONS: 001/33 for change and for new-member creation, 021/025 add, 024 term, 030 in the audit file. FACETS: eligibility spans live in CMC_SBEL_ELIG_ENT / CMC_SBEL_ELIG_EVT with event codes SL (select), CH (change) and TM (term); a new member must populate SBEL, SBSG, SBSB, MEME, SBAD, SBCS, MEPR, MECM, MECD, MEIA, MEST and MELC. Plan codes for this story: MCMIZMAE / MCMIZDAE non-BH, MCMIZMAJ BH, MCMIZMHE and MCMIZMHJ the HMP variants; HD04 values MHPCMCFMAMC and MHPCMCFMAHMPMC. Per the story comments the TM event is REMOVED from AC 7, 10, 12, 13, 14, 15 and 16 wherever eligibility has no gap - do not assert a TM span in those conditions. COVERAGE follows the story's own matrix: (DTP*348 earlier than DTP*344 vs DTP*348 later than DTP*344) x (both dates before 10/01/2026 vs both on or after 10/01/2026) x (new member vs update to an existing member already in Facets), plus the crosswalk row/column validations, the BH-termed-while-member-active case, the member-fully-termed case, the multiple-COB-loop EDIStageArchive case, and the two regression conditions (plan assignment unchanged without BH-Cover, derived date unchanged without BH-Cover). Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, Edifecs pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, EDIStageArchive SQL validation including MemberCOB, crosswalk SQL validation, and Facets SBEL span validation - at 5 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case.
